title: Unary polynomial generator
statement: For natural numbers $C$ and $e$, define a Boolean Turing machine with $e+1$ work tapes. When $e=0$, it emits the fixed word of $C$ ones, independently of its input; when $e>0$, it is the catalog generator that, on an input of length $n$, emits $C(n+1)^e$ ones.
